patterns.name: Bullish Engulfing
patterns.description: A bullish candle whose body fully covers the prior bearish candle's body.
conditions: current candle body engulfs previous candle body
current candle closes higher than it opened
patterns.invalidation: next candle closes below the engulfing candle's low

patterns.name: Bearish Engulfing
patterns.description: A bearish candle whose body fully covers the prior bullish candle's body.
conditions: current candle body engulfs previous candle body
current candle closes lower than it opened
patterns.invalidation: next candle closes above the engulfing candle's high

patterns.name: Bullish Pin Bar / Hammer
patterns.description: Small body with a long lower wick, showing strong rejection of lower prices.
conditions: lower wick at least 2x the body size
small upper wick
forms at or near a support level
patterns.invalidation: close below the pin bar's low
confluence_boost: after liquidity sweep of a swing low

patterns.name: Bearish Pin Bar / Shooting Star
patterns.description: Small body with a long upper wick, showing strong rejection of higher prices.
conditions: upper wick at least 2x the body size
small lower wick
forms at or near a resistance level
patterns.invalidation: close above the pin bar's high
confluence_boost: after liquidity sweep of a swing high

patterns.name: Double Bottom
patterns.description: Two swing lows at a similar level with a pullback between them, suggesting selling exhaustion.
conditions: two lows within a small tolerance of each other
clear pullback (neckline) between the two lows

patterns.name: Double Top
patterns.description: Two swing highs at a similar level with a pullback between them, suggesting buying exhaustion.
conditions: two highs within a small tolerance of each other
clear pullback (neckline) between the two highs

patterns.name: Bullish Breakout & Retest
patterns.description: Price closes decisively above resistance, then returns to retest it as new support before continuing higher.
conditions: decisive close above resistance
pullback to the broken level
rejection candle at the retest
patterns.invalidation: close back below the retested level with continuation lower

patterns.name: Bearish Breakout & Retest
patterns.description: Price closes decisively below support, then returns to retest it as new resistance before continuing lower.
conditions: decisive close below support
pullback to the broken level
rejection candle at the retest
patterns.invalidation: close back above the retested level with continuation higher
